verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents a RESTful API for pulling data, an MCP integration for AI assistants (including analyzing data in Claude), API retrieval of campaign reports and link clicks, and a CLI that manages subscribers, campaigns, and automations. Together these let an agent reach the main parts of the email program, but none of the evidence shows the API or MCP reading automation status or performance, or listing audiences and segments in one pull. missing for 10: explicit documentation of reading live automation status and performance via API/MCP, documented programmatic retrieval of segments/groups as audiences, an end-to-end agent reporting workflow across all three data types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working
